_comment: Drift-guard floors for `mortgage-data match mbs-umbs check`. Pinned 2026-07-05 from the post-fix runs (FNMA 22,049,149 pairs, r1_share 0.989, FPD-2019 98.5%, 2020-24 99.8-99.9%; FHLMC 16,459,858, r1_share 0.995, 2019 97.5%, 2020-24 99.1-99.6%). Floors are deliberately loose: they catch the catastrophic collapses that upstream encoding drift produces (rates falling by tens of points, round 1 emptying out), not sub-point fluctuations. The 2019 floor guards the snapshot seam windowing; the round1_share floor guards MIP null-vs-0 harmonization (round 2 absorbs what round 1 loses, so totals alone would not flag it). Update deliberately when a genuine improvement shifts the plateau; recency-affected years are not pinned.
